en.name: Spaghetti squash, whole
en.summary: Spaghetti squash is a pale yellow winter squash whose cooked flesh pulls apart into long strands. Whole and uncut it keeps about 2 months in a cool room, and — unusually — refrigerating it makes things worse, cutting that to 1–2 weeks.
en.pantry: A whole spaghetti squash is a pantry vegetable, and the pantry is genuinely the right place: about two months from purchase, kept in a cool, dry, dark and airy spot. Do not stack them, do not bag them, and keep them off a cold floor. The hard rind is what does the work, so handle them gently — a bruise or a puncture is where rot starts, and a damaged squash will not see out the month.
en.fridge: This is the unusual part: storage temperatures below about 10 °C (50 °F), which includes any refrigerator, cause spaghetti squash to spoil more rapidly, cutting it to 1–2 weeks. The fridge is therefore not an upgrade on the pantry for a whole squash — it is a downgrade, and a significant one. Use it only if you have nowhere cool, or once the squash has been cut, in which case wrap the cut faces tightly and use it within a few days.
en.freezer: There is no freezer timeline for whole spaghetti squash in our data, and freezing it whole is impractical in any case. The useful approach is to roast it, pull the flesh into strands with a fork, cool it, drain it well and freeze the strands in portions at −18 °C (0 °F), where food stays safe indefinitely. No quality window has been published, so we do not quote one. Frozen strands are softer than fresh and are best reheated in a sauce.
en.thawing: Reheat frozen cooked strands from frozen, in a pan with the sauce, and drain off the water they release. Do not thaw them slowly, which leaves them sitting in their own liquid and turns them to mush.
spoilage: Soft or sunken patches, especially where the squash rested on a surface
Mould at the stem scar or on a bruise
A rind that gives when pressed with a thumbnail rather than resisting
Weeping liquid, or a sour smell around the stem
tips: Choose a squash that feels heavy, with a hard rind and a dry, intact stem.
Keep it in a cool dry airy place, not the fridge and not on a cold floor.
Do not stack them; pressure points become soft spots.
Pierce it a few times before roasting whole, or halve it, so it does not burst.

faq.q: How long does a whole spaghetti squash last?
faq.a: About 2 months in a cool, dry, dark place from the day of purchase. In the fridge it only lasts 1–2 weeks.
Not while it is whole. Below about 10 °C (50 °F) it spoils more rapidly, so the fridge shortens its life considerably. Refrigerate only cut squash.
Not usefully whole, and no timeline is published. Roast it, fork the flesh into strands, drain and freeze the strands in portions at −18 °C (0 °F).

faq.q: Why does my spaghetti squash come out watery?
faq.a: It holds a lot of water. Roast it cut-side down until the strands separate easily, then let them drain in a colander before saucing them.

zh.name: 金絲瓜（整顆）
zh.summary: 金絲瓜是淡黃色的冬南瓜，煮熟後果肉可以用叉子刮成一條條長絲。整顆未切開放在涼爽室內約可放兩個月；而且很少見地，冷藏反而會讓它更糟，只剩 1～2 週。
zh.pantry: 整顆金絲瓜就是該放儲藏室的蔬菜，而且那真的是正確的位置：從購買日起約兩個月，放在陰涼、乾燥、避光且通風的地方。不要堆疊、不要裝袋，也不要直接放在冰冷的地板上。真正在保護它的是那層硬皮，所以搬動時要輕——碰傷或戳破的地方就是腐爛的起點，受傷的瓜撐不到一個月。
zh.fridge: 這裡是特別的地方：低於約 10°C 的保存溫度——也就是任何一台冰箱——會讓金絲瓜腐敗得更快，把保存期縮短到 1～2 週。所以對整顆瓜來說，冰箱不是升級而是明顯的降級。只有在家裡真的沒有涼爽處，或是瓜已經切開時才用冷藏；切開的話請把切面包緊，並在幾天內用完。
zh.freezer: 我們的資料裡沒有整顆金絲瓜的冷凍保存期限，何況整顆冷凍本來也不切實際。實用的做法是：先烤熟，用叉子把果肉刮成絲，放涼、徹底瀝乾後分裝冷凍於 −18°C，在該溫度下安全上可無限期保存。既然沒有公布的品質期限，我們就不引用數字。冷凍過的瓜絲比新鮮的軟，最適合連同醬汁一起加熱。
zh.thawing: 冷凍的熟瓜絲請不解凍，直接連同醬汁下鍋加熱，並把釋出的水瀝掉。不要慢慢解凍，那會讓它一直泡在自己的水裡，最後糊掉。
spoilage: 出現軟塌或凹陷的部位，尤其是接觸檯面的那一面
蒂頭疤痕或碰傷處長黴
用指甲按壓外皮會凹陷，而不是硬挺有抵抗
有滲出的汁液，或蒂頭附近散發酸味
tips: 挑拿起來有重量、外皮硬實、蒂頭乾燥完整的。
放在陰涼乾燥通風處，不要放冰箱，也不要直接放冰冷地板上。
不要堆疊；受壓處就會變成軟爛點。
整顆烤之前先戳幾個洞，或直接對切，避免爆開。

faq.q: 整顆金絲瓜可以放多久？
faq.a: 從購買當天算起，放在陰涼乾燥避光處約兩個月。放冰箱反而只有 1～2 週。
整顆的不要。低於約 10°C 它會腐敗得更快，冷藏會明顯縮短保存期。只有切開的才需要冷藏。
整顆冷凍沒有意義，也沒有公布的期限。請先烤熟、刮成絲、瀝乾後分裝冷凍於 −18°C。

faq.q: 金絲瓜煮出來為什麼水水的？
faq.a: 它含水量很高。請切面朝下烤到瓜絲能輕鬆分離，然後放在濾網裡瀝乾再拌醬。
